== Published text and image provenance ==
The 25 November 2020 Rules Team announcement changes the destination wording for the just-lost character. Appendix A supplies the complete wording. Aglets, Players Committee Rules Team, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1322117#p1322117 Current Rulings Archive], 25 November 2020, Someone Who Loves You. Players Committee, [https://swccg.com/wiki/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=128 PC Appendix A], Appendix A, PDF page 128.

The [https://swccg.com/wiki/Special:PermanentLink/343407 previous wiki revision] transcribes a publisher data record that predates the announcement. The [[:File:JP-L-someonewholovesyou.gif|previous face]] shows the Original wording and the lore word “apprehension.” The file remains preserved. The [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/00702b1f0d90eb9458dc75008dc4e8a0176905bb/Light.json 10 November 2020 data record], the [https://www.theforce.net/ccg/sw/spoilers/jabbaspalace.pdf#page=3 2001 spoiler], and the [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/473041b13f5573c8cd76eacbc28d6b741e8da887/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set6/light/Card6_075.java GEMP source class] share the different transcription. The published text article uses a publication identity and has a blank card-face and GEMP mapping.
